Judge Dismisses Trump Lawsuit Against Iowa Newspaper

An Iowa judge has dismissed a lawsuit filed by Donald Trump against The Des Moines Register and a pollster. Trump had accused the newspaper of fraudulently publishing inaccurate poll results to damage him. The poll in question showed Trump trailing Kamala Harris in the final weeks of the 2024 race. The judge warned that such legal challenges could have a chilling effect on news reporting.
